author: Bobby Grayson
title: BLOCKED, and not by a translator gap. Batch B already took it from distance 2 to distance 1: the only walker blocker left is Search.build_index/0 and the translator dies at 'case scrutinee ... got Search.validate_and_search(query, tab)'. Both are calls into BigBill.Search, a SQLite full-text index. build_index/0 is run for its effect on the index; validate_and_search/2 returns {:ok, results, counts} | {:error, :too_short} and is the case scrutinee of run_search/3. Neither has a sound image in the model: the model has no opaque unknown value (Term is a concrete Nat-backed structure with DecidableEq) and EBehavior has no nondeterministic branch, so a case over an unknown tagged union cannot be expressed. Left blocked.
